latest_rss.title: Graphics: The numbers behind China-US bilateral trade
latest_rss.summary: The United States and China, the world's two largest economies, have agreed to build a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity, with cooperation as its main theme.  Trade is one of the most measurable forms of that cooperation. From 2001 to 2025, US goods exports to China grew 454.2%, more than double the 198.6% growth in exports to the rest of the world. In 2025, China was the largest export market for US soybeans, the second-largest for integrated circuits and the third-largest for medical devices. The US was also the largest contributor to China's services trade deficit.  These figures reflect the mutually beneficial nature of economic ties between the two countries.
